title: Linear Cosine Palettes(2025)
summary: A blog post by DJ Navarro exploring a mathematical approach to generating color palettes using cosine functions, offering a more systematic alternative to traditional gradient interpolation methods.
problem_solved: Creating smooth, aesthetically pleasing color palettes with precise mathematical control rather than relying on ad-hoc interpolation.
why_valuable: Provides data scientists, artists, and developers with a principled, reproducible method for generating color gradients based on trigonometric functions, making palette creation more deterministic and customizable.
